[D5]He hung on the windswept
world tree [B5]Whose
[F#5]roots no one

pierced [B5]By
[F#5]Gugnir, his spear
Swim-

[D5]Reaching out he grasped the
runes Before [B5]fal-

He

self In [B5]a
